capabilities: Search book metadata across Kitapyurdu, D&R, Open Library, and Hardcover
Merge and deduplicate cross-provider results in a comparison modal
Create reading notes from static, reactive, or custom templates
Download cover images locally into the vault
Render 3D library card code blocks with SVG ISBN barcodes
extras: Fully bilingual Turkish/English documentation; all network requests run client-side with no telemetry; beta versions available via BRAT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up bibliographic metadata, especially from Turkish bookstores, when creating reading notes.

relations.evidence: Automatically evaluates Templater syntax upon note creation and exposes the raw book object
Reactive Template (Dataview & Templater): Built-in visual reading progress bar

summary: Book search plugin that queries Kitapyurdu, D&R, Open Library, and Hardcover and creates structured bibliographic reading notes.
